question: African WNNN country title: Country Lead and Deputy Country Lead, or Country Representative and Deputy as in the diaspora
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Both sets of titles are kept. Africa shows the title chosen under System rules; the diaspora always shows Country Representative.

question: Does reaching 30 members activate a chapter, or make it eligible?
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: The chapter is marked eligible. It is not activated silently. HQ activates it.

question: Is 50 a universal hard maximum, or can a country set its own?
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Hard maximum of 50. A country figure can be entered under System rules and every change is versioned.

question: Automatic chapter creation, split thresholds and catchment tie-break
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: A member is placed in an existing chapter with room. If there is none she is held as pending placement and stays a full member. Automatic creation is built behind a switch and should stay off until approved.

question: Account recovery without OTP on shared or lost devices
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Fingerprint or face (passkey) where the phone supports it, an email link where the member gave an email, and reset by HQ. A leader-assisted reset is built behind a switch and should stay off until approved.

question: Governance of exceptional safeguarding and security cases
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: A separate confidential lane that only HQ case handlers see. A person named in a case never sees it. Nothing is sanctioned automatically.

question: Is completing three referrals enforced?
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: A growth milestone. Nobody is excluded or held back for not reaching it.

question: WNNN member turning 30
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: The Person ID and every record stay. WDOS tells the member and lists her for HQ. Nothing changes network by itself and no WGMN role is ever given automatically.

question: The ordinary seven-day screening criteria
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Short, objective, non-invasive questions with equal text and audio routes and an open retry. No staff step.

question: Approval of all five languages, audio and video
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Arabic, English, French, Portuguese and Swahili are present as working versions. None is approved until a human reviewer signs each one.

question: Country geography and ward to cluster mappings
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Official wards are stored apart from WODDI Community Clusters. A cluster is not called a ward.

question: He-for-She appointment eligibility and rights
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Deputy, assistant or administrative secretary only, by formal appointment, with rights limited to the appointed scope.

question: Consent, privacy, cross-border transfers and minors in programme contexts
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: Nobody under 18 can register. Members can download their own record and ask for closure. Legal review is still required before go-live.

question: Service levels, recovery objectives, concurrency and operating budget
guardrail_wdos_runs_on: No figure is promised. Baselines are to be measured and signed.
